details.method: Before asserting cancellation or stale-result rejection, verify that the real asynchronous operation started; include the observed helper request or worker-start evidence in test success conditions.
details.when: An editor fixture mutates state before starting an async operation and later checks only an empty field or unchanged result.
details.counterexample: A test intentionally covering rejection before start should instead assert no launch; start evidence does not by itself prove successful completion.
details.trial_plan: Run exact corrected memory fixture; then run a temporary copy omitting only the new pre-race verify. Corrected case must pass with two initial saves; negative copy must be rejected by pending_save_observed even when its control assertions pass.
